title: nixos/avahi-daemon: disable the full mDNS NSS module by default
reason: Applicable: changed-file list includes nixos/modules/services/networking/avahi-daemon.nix. Wired test confirmed: nixos/tests/all-tests.nix at head (e8e86c94) contains 'avahi = runTest { imports = [ ./avahi.nix ]; ... }' and 'avahi-with-resolved = runTest { imports = [ ./avahi.nix ]; ... }' (lines 251-257). Consistent with a prior S4-A batch note that avahi-daemon.nix was already found applicable there.
targets_toml: single target avahi-daemon, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,avahi], watch=[enable, nssmdnsFull]. The real diff adds a genuinely new option declaration `nssmdnsFull = lib.mkOption { type = lib.types.bool; default = false; ... }` plus a new assertion and a config-body change gating the full mDNS NSS module behind it. Baseline services.avahi.enable (mkOption at line 60 of the head module) was confirmed present; watched alongside the new nssmdnsFull.

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: Unchanged on both sides (not PASS either side); no PASS-involving asymmetry.

Raw fact only: nssmdnsFull does not exist in base (option genuinely added by this PR, OptionNotFound is expected there). In head it is a real declared option (bool, default false) whose only predicate site is `lib.mkAfter (lib.optional cfg.nssmdnsFull "${mdns}")` at nixos/modules/services/networking/avahi-daemon.nix:346 -- oba classifies this as TestConfigUnresolved rather than PredicateNotFound or PASS/FAIL. Neither side is PASS, so this does not meet the strict PASS-involving-asymmetric-transition criterion, but it is the only changed watched identity for this PR (matches raw.json's oba_verdict_transitions['option_not_found->test_config_unresolved']=1) and is flagged for the reviewer since nixos/tests/avahi.nix does not appear to set services.avahi.nssmdnsFull at all in either the base or head test file (confirmed by inspecting the fetched nixos/tests/avahi.nix content at both SHAs).
